ai_analysis.summary: This document contains highly onerous terms between the Client and AcmeCorp that heavily favor the vendor. It obligates the Client to indemnify AcmeCorp even for its own gross negligence, adhere to strict Net-5 payment terms with exorbitant late fees, and absorb unannounced fee hikes of up to 300%. Additionally, it locks the Client into 10-year auto-renewals unless cancelled exactly 365 days in advance.
obligations: Client must assume 100% legal liability and indemnify AcmeCorp against all claims, including those resulting from AcmeCorp's own gross negligence.
Client must settle invoices under Net-5 payment terms.
Client must pay a compounding daily interest rate of 5% on any late payments.
Client must absorb licensing fee increases of up to 300% instituted without prior written notice.
Client must provide written notice of non-renewal exactly 365 days prior to expiration to prevent automatic renewal.
deadlines: Invoice payment due within 5 days of receipt (Net-5 terms).
Written notice of non-renewal must be provided exactly 365 days prior to agreement expiration.
Automatic renewal occurs upon expiration for successive 10-year terms.
ai_analysis.risk_explanation: This contract represents maximum legal and financial risk (10/10). It forces the Client to assume liability for AcmeCorp's gross negligence, imposes punitive 5% daily compounding late fees, permits arbitrary fee increases of up to 300% without notice, and includes a predatory 10-year auto-renewal clause with an inflexible notice requirement.
